title: CLI-First: paper and replication package
description: The paper, with its data, harness and analysis: 'CLI-First: What an Agent Knows About an Interface Matters More Than Its Protocol': 947 attempted and 704 retained Claude Code runs on salli-core, two follow-up experiments (1,056 runs), with transcripts, the run ledger, collection logs and the scripts that produce every number in the paper.
